lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in an irregular grid-like pattern posterior to the pectoral fin; spatial density decreases posteriorly along the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal spot rows to form grid-like nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank; the most dorsal ridge exhibits a sharp intensity gradient with lighter pixels on top and a linear shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs scattered primarily across the anterior and central regions of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density micro-spot patterning on the rostrum; presence of commensal organisms attached near the ventral-pectoral junction and trailing the dorsal fin.
